{{Quote|Remember the story I told you? Evona fell to darkness, and Ardos exploded in rage. Ardos is our white dwarf. Varl is in orbit around Ardos.''"<br />"''But Varl is a dead planet. The Jedi Archives were clear on that.''"<br />"''Maybe not as dead as we thought.|[[Reen Irana]], [[Mander Zuma]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Ardos''' was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary]] [[Star/Legends|star]] with [[Evona/Legends|Evona]] in the [[Varl system/Legends|Varl system]], and the original homeworld of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. According to Hutt legend, Ardos became angry and vented off its layers of gas, destroying the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the orbiting [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], after Evona was swallowed by a black hole. In truth, by the time the Hutts established themselves on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Ardos was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] type star.
